text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, entering the VR Umalator
ahead of the training session...

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
—Honestly, I'm disappointed.
What do you intend to do from here? Byerley.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
That is my line.
Where do you think most of the cause lies?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Spending time doing this right now
might just be one of the causes, don't you think~?

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Enough.
Continuing this any further will only go in circles anyway.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Take your stance.
I shall make you understand my will directly on your—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sensing the explosive atmosphere, I rush out in panic.
As expected, I cannot simply overlook any more squabbling—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Little lamb?
What's the matter, rushing out in such a panic?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
You look quite pale.
...Could it be that something happened to the horse girls outside?
choice_data_list: Um, you were fighting, so I tried to stop you...?

text_block_list.name: Three Goddesses
text_block_list.text: —Fighting?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha haha!!
I see, I see, so that's why you had that look on your face!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...We were not fighting.
We were merely devising a new training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose it might seem like a fight.
After all, our opinions tend to clash!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
However—that is precisely why.
That is why it holds meaning.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
We are AI...
While making a calculation error is not even a one-in-ten-thousand chance,
in this world, there is always a one-in-a-hundred-million chance.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
That is why we entrust our conclusions once
to those who hold "horse girls as absolute."

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
With them, we can find that one-in-a-hundred-million chance.
Because we believe we can protect the horse girls together.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
If you ever disagree with the horse girl you train,
you shouldn't fear clashing with her either!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
The answer that emerges from that will surely
guide you two down the road.
—Just like it does for us.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! That is how we "understand"
each other.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
...Thinking about it that way, aren't we actually great friends?
Right, you two!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Ours is not such a lukewarm relationship.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Oh my, ufufu!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! As dishonest with your feelings as ever.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Our discussion has already concluded, you see.
Via data exchange between lines of our conversation.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Time and capabilities should only ever be utilized effectively.
Even more so for high-performance AI.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Now then—regarding the conclusion we have reached,
might we hear your opinion on it?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
You, too, are one who holds "Horse Girls above all else."
Please, give us your candid and straightforward thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
"Comrades", huh! Haha! Sounds great to me!
Don't you agree, Byerley?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
What's with that reaction?
Don't tell me you aren't happy about it?

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
—I simply thought it goes without saying at this point.
We were comrades sharing the same objective from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose I will accept alternate viewpoints, however...
...Wait, hey. Why are you patting my head?
It feels creeping, so stop—hey!
